response.sql: WITH frequency_stats AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_stats) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed_amount) as avg_of_avg_signed_amounts, AVG(f.avg_balance) as avg_of_avg_balances, AVG(f.avg_signed_amount - o.mean_signed_amount) as avg_excess_over_mean FROM frequency_stats f CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE f.avg_signed_amount > o.mean_signed_amount;
